title: Label unlabeled issues and PRs
body:
This task involved identifying all unlabeled open issues and pull requests in the beercss/beercss repository and applying the most appropriate label from the set: enhancement, question, duplicate, documentation, or bug. 

Using a user-provided Personal Access Token, 21 items were labeled:
- 10 items were labeled as 'bug'.
- 11 items were labeled as 'enhancement'.

No local code changes were necessary as the task was completed directly via the GitHub REST API.
